Dialogs.Dialog: ...No one is watching. Now's my chance▼
We're both thinking the same thing right now, aren't we？
You know without me saying it, right？
And here I thought... no, never mind.
Actually, I was hoping... Just kidding.
No, I can't after all. That's all for today.
Maybe I'll try teasing you for once... Just kidding.
What's going to happen to me？
I love that about you too...
I feel like I'll be pulled right into you.
Sorry. Will you love on me again？
Sorry I was cold to you. I love you. I love you so much...
Um... what time is it, I wonder？
Because I want to stay like this.
I can't put it into words...
It's like a dream... I think.
I wonder if this moment will last forever...
No... ah, I don't mean no...
What's going to happen to me...
Is it okay for me to be this clingy？
Because I love you so much...
What do I do, this is so...
How far are you going to go？
It keeps feeling better and better...
Always the same spot... no fair.
Mm... don't listen to my voice.
If you don't, I'll be upset.
I think I can feel your heart racing.
I love you even more now.
I'm your Manaka and no one else's...
A secret from Papa and Mama...
Geez, that was on purpose, wasn't it？
I'm going to... do it too.
Do you know what I'm thinking？
You scored a smash on me... Just kidding.
Hey, I want you to cover my lips...
That's it？ No, I want to kiss more.
My lips are still lonely, you know...？
Sorry. I can't seem to stop...
I'm fine, but... are you still okay？
We kissed a hundred times. Still not enough？
I can't see anyone but you anymore...
It's kind of scary... don't let go.
I love you most in the world...▼
...It felt so good I spaced out.
My heart is full of your love▼
It seems I'm already yours, forever.
Hehe, my lips are already lonely▼
We understood each other... didn't we？
I want to kiss every day... Just kidding.
This feeling right now... let's treasure it.
Is it okay to be this lovey-dovey？
You gave me so much energy.
Just being together makes me happy...
At a time like this, it made me nervous...
...It's not that I hate it, but.
I shouldn't be happy about something like this, geez...
Once in a while is nice... maybe. Just kidding.
Don't look at my face... it's bright red.
You think I can't say no, don't you？
I won't always let you get away with it...
